services.desc: We will take you on a sea cruise along the enchanted coastal waterway or head offshore for more adventure! Bring your favorite food and beverages (BYOB) for the best time out on the water with your crew. We provide a galley fully stocked and ready to keep your items ice cold in the fridge and freezer. We also have awesome catering options to choose from as well; Caviar and Bananas, Fast and French, and Sullivan’s Board Co. Relax with a sail out to a barrier island, anchor out and enjoy the cool summer breezes while dining in the shaded spacious cockpit of Windchaser, our 50 ft luxury sailing yacht.
